D2 and E2 by endoperoxide isomerase. Furthermore, GSH contributes to the glutathionylation of proteins (e.g., thioredoxin,
ubiquitin-conjugating enzyme, and cytochrome c oxidase). Finally, GSH maintains cellular redox state, confers anti-infectious
effects (Diotallevi et al., 2017), and reduces the susceptibility of humans to SARS (Wu et al., 2004) and COVID-19 (Polonikov,
2020; Silvagno et al., 2020).
